```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(shiny)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(leafem)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

options(width = 100)
terraOptions(progress = 0)

orthomosaic_path <- "data/rgb_orthomosaic.tif"
plots_path <- "data/plot_boundaries.geojson"

if (!file.exists(orthomosaic_path)) stop("Missing data/rgb_orthomosaic.tif")
if (!file.exists(plots_path)) stop("Missing data/plot_boundaries.geojson")

rgb_raw <- terra::rast(orthomosaic_path)
plots_raw <- terra::vect(plots_path)

if (terra::nlyr(rgb_raw) < 3) {
  stop("The RGB orthomosaic must contain at least three bands.")
}

# Use the first three bands. Expected order: Red, Green, Blue.
rgb_raw <- rgb_raw[[1:3]]
names(rgb_raw) <- c("Red", "Green", "Blue")

plot_id_candidates <- c("plot_id", "Plot_ID", "plot", "Plot", "id", "ID")
plot_id_matches <- plot_id_candidates[plot_id_candidates %in% names(plots_raw)]

if (length(plot_id_matches) == 0) {
  plots_raw$plot_id <- paste0("Plot_", seq_len(nrow(plots_raw)))
  plot_id_field <- "plot_id"
} else {
  plot_id_field <- plot_id_matches[[1]]
}

safe_gli <- function(red, green, blue) {
  denominator <- 2 * green + red + blue
  terra::ifel(
    denominator == 0,
    NA,
    (2 * green - red - blue) / denominator
  )
}

calculate_otsu_threshold <- function(raster, sample_size = 100000, bins = 256) {
  requested_size <- min(sample_size, terra::ncell(raster))
  sampled <- terra::spatSample(
    raster,
    size = requested_size,
    method = "regular",
    na.rm = TRUE,
    values = TRUE
  )

  pixel_values <- as.numeric(sampled[, 1])
  pixel_values <- pixel_values[is.finite(pixel_values)]

  if (length(pixel_values) < 2) {
    stop("Not enough valid GLI values for Otsu thresholding.")
  }

  h <- hist(pixel_values, breaks = bins, plot = FALSE)
  probabilities <- h$counts / sum(h$counts)
  cumulative_probability <- cumsum(probabilities)
  cumulative_mean <- cumsum(probabilities * h$mids)
  total_mean <- sum(probabilities * h$mids)
  denominator <- cumulative_probability * (1 - cumulative_probability)

  between_class_variance <-
    (total_mean * cumulative_probability - cumulative_mean)^2 / denominator
  between_class_variance[!is.finite(between_class_variance)] <- NA_real_

  h$mids[which.max(between_class_variance)]
}

make_aligned_plots <- function(raster, polygons) {
  if (is.na(terra::crs(raster, proj = TRUE)) || !nzchar(terra::crs(raster, proj = TRUE))) {
    stop("The RGB orthomosaic does not contain a valid coordinate reference system.")
  }

  if (is.na(terra::crs(polygons, proj = TRUE)) || !nzchar(terra::crs(polygons, proj = TRUE))) {
    stop("The plot boundary layer does not contain a valid coordinate reference system.")
  }

  if (!terra::same.crs(raster, polygons)) {
    polygons <- terra::project(polygons, terra::crs(raster))
  }

  polygons
}
```

## Welcome

This self-paced workflow converts RGB orthomosaic pixels into plot-level crop traits.

### Learning objectives

1. Inspect and interactively visualize an RGB orthomosaic.
2. Assign Red, Green, and Blue band names.
3. Calculate the Green Leaf Index (GLI).
4. Calculate an Otsu threshold from the GLI distribution.
5. Create a binary vegetation segmentation mask.
6. Mask non-vegetation pixels from the RGB orthomosaic and GLI layer.
7. Overlay experimental plot boundaries.
8. Extract mean vegetation GLI and canopy cover for every plot.
9. Export a plot-level crop-trait table.

> **Important:** This tutorial assumes the band order is Red, Green, Blue. Verify the band order from the image or camera metadata before using another dataset.

## Activity 1: Inspect the RGB orthomosaic

A raster is a grid of cells. Each RGB cell contains Red, Green, and Blue values.

```{r inspect-raster, exercise=TRUE}

rgb
terra::nlyr(rgb)
terra::res(rgb)
terra::ext(rgb)
terra::crs(rgb)
```

```{r inspect-raster-solution}
rgb <- rgb_raw

print(rgb)
cat("Number of bands:", terra::nlyr(rgb), "\n")
cat("Rows and columns:", terra::nrow(rgb), "x", terra::ncol(rgb), "\n")
cat("Resolution:", paste(terra::res(rgb), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("Extent:", paste(c(terra::xmin(rgb), terra::xmax(rgb), terra::ymin(rgb), terra::ymax(rgb)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("CRS:", terra::crs(rgb), "\n")
```

```{r band-viewer-server, context="server", echo=FALSE}
output$band_map <- renderLeaflet({
```

### Fully interactive RGB composite

Use the map below to zoom, pan, switch layers, and click any location. The clicked pixel's Red, Green, and Blue values are displayed beneath the map.

```{r rgb-map-ui, echo=FALSE}
leafletOutput("rgb_composite_map", height = "620px")
uiOutput("rgb_pixel_readout")
```

```{r rgb-map-server, context="server", echo=FALSE}
output$rgb_composite_map <- renderLeaflet({
  leaflet(options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE)) |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, group = "Light basemap") |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") |>
    leafem::addRasterRGB(
      rgb_raw,
      r = 1,
      g = 2,
      b = 3,
      quantiles = c(0.02, 0.98),
      opacity = 1,
      group = "RGB orthomosaic",
      project = TRUE
    ) |>
    addLayersControl(
      baseGroups = c("Light basemap", "Satellite"),
      overlayGroups = "RGB orthomosaic",
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
    )
})

rgb_clicked_values <- reactive({
  click <- input$rgb_composite_map_click
  shiny::req(click)

  coordinates <- matrix(c(click$lng, click$lat), ncol = 2)

  # Leaflet clicks are longitude/latitude. Transform to raster CRS when needed.
  click_point <- terra::vect(coordinates, type = "points", crs = "EPSG:4326")
  if (!terra::same.crs(click_point, rgb_raw)) {
    click_point <- terra::project(click_point, terra::crs(rgb_raw))
  }

  extracted <- terra::extract(rgb_raw, click_point)
  if (nrow(extracted) == 0) return(NULL)

  as.numeric(extracted[1, c("Red", "Green", "Blue")])
})

output$rgb_pixel_readout <- renderUI({
  values <- rgb_clicked_values()

  if (is.null(values) || any(!is.finite(values))) {
    return(div(class = "alert alert-info", "Click a valid pixel inside the RGB orthomosaic."))
  }

  gli_value <- (2 * values[2] - values[1] - values[3]) /
    (2 * values[2] + values[1] + values[3])

  fluidRow(
    column(3, div(class = "well", strong("Red"), br(), round(values[1], 3))),
    column(3, div(class = "well", strong("Green"), br(), round(values[2], 3))),
    column(3, div(class = "well", strong("Blue"), br(), round(values[3], 3))),
    column(3, div(class = "well", strong("GLI"), br(), round(gli_value, 4)))
  )
})
```

## Activity 4: Build a vegetation index formula interactively

Instead of only copying a finished formula, construct an index by selecting bands, coefficients, and mathematical operations. The general expression is:

\[
Index = \frac{(a \times Band_A)\; operator_1\; (b \times Band_B)\; operator_2\; (c \times Band_C)}{(d \times Band_D)\; operator_3\; (e \times Band_E)\; operator_4\; (f \times Band_F)}
\]

For GLI, configure the builder as:

```text
Numerator:   (2 × Green) − (1 × Red) − (1 × Blue)
Denominator: (2 × Green) + (1 × Red) + (1 × Blue)
```

```{r formula-builder-ui, echo=FALSE}
wellPanel(
  h4("Numerator"),
  fluidRow(
    column(2, numericInput("num_a", "Coefficient a", 2, step = 1)),
    column(2, selectInput("num_band_a", "Band A", c("Red", "Green", "Blue"), "Green")),
    column(2, selectInput("num_op_1", "Operator 1", c("+", "-", "*", "/"), "-")),
    column(2, numericInput("num_b", "Coefficient b", 1, step = 1)),
    column(2, selectInput("num_band_b", "Band B", c("Red", "Green", "Blue"), "Red")),
    column(2, selectInput("num_op_2", "Operator 2", c("+", "-", "*", "/"), "-"))
  ),
  fluidRow(
    column(2, numericInput("num_c", "Coefficient c", 1, step = 1)),
    column(2, selectInput("num_band_c", "Band C", c("Red", "Green", "Blue"), "Blue"))
  ),
  hr(),
  h4("Denominator"),
  fluidRow(
    column(2, numericInput("den_a", "Coefficient d", 2, step = 1)),
    column(2, selectInput("den_band_a", "Band D", c("Red", "Green", "Blue"), "Green")),
    column(2, selectInput("den_op_1", "Operator 3", c("+", "-", "*", "/"), "+")),
    column(2, numericInput("den_b", "Coefficient e", 1, step = 1)),
    column(2, selectInput("den_band_b", "Band E", c("Red", "Green", "Blue"), "Red")),
    column(2, selectInput("den_op_2", "Operator 4", c("+", "-", "*", "/"), "+"))
  ),
  fluidRow(
    column(2, numericInput("den_c", "Coefficient f", 1, step = 1)),
    column(2, selectInput("den_band_c", "Band F", c("Red", "Green", "Blue"), "Blue"))
  ),
  actionButton("calculate_custom_index", "Calculate Index", class = "btn-primary")
)

uiOutput("formula_preview")
uiOutput("formula_feedback")
leafletOutput("custom_index_map", height = "600px")
plotlyOutput("custom_index_histogram", height = "350px")
```

```{r formula-builder-server, context="server", echo=FALSE}
apply_operation <- function(left, operator, right) {
  switch(
    operator,
    "+" = left + right,
    "-" = left - right,
    "*" = left * right,
    "/" = terra::ifel(right == 0, NA, left / right)
  )
}

selected_raster_band <- function(name) rgb_raw[[name]]

formula_text <- reactive({
  paste0(
    "[(", input$num_a, " × ", input$num_band_a, ") ", input$num_op_1,
    " (", input$num_b, " × ", input$num_band_b, ") ", input$num_op_2,
    " (", input$num_c, " × ", input$num_band_c, ")] / [(",
    input$den_a, " × ", input$den_band_a, ") ", input$den_op_1,
    " (", input$den_b, " × ", input$den_band_b, ") ", input$den_op_2,
    " (", input$den_c, " × ", input$den_band_c, ")]"
  )
})

output$formula_preview <- renderUI({
  div(class = "alert alert-info", strong("Current formula: "), formula_text())
})

custom_index <- eventReactive(input$calculate_custom_index, {
  numerator_1 <- input$num_a * selected_raster_band(input$num_band_a)
  numerator_2 <- input$num_b * selected_raster_band(input$num_band_b)
  numerator_3 <- input$num_c * selected_raster_band(input$num_band_c)
  numerator <- apply_operation(numerator_1, input$num_op_1, numerator_2)
  numerator <- apply_operation(numerator, input$num_op_2, numerator_3)

  denominator_1 <- input$den_a * selected_raster_band(input$den_band_a)
  denominator_2 <- input$den_b * selected_raster_band(input$den_band_b)
  denominator_3 <- input$den_c * selected_raster_band(input$den_band_c)
  denominator <- apply_operation(denominator_1, input$den_op_1, denominator_2)
  denominator <- apply_operation(denominator, input$den_op_2, denominator_3)

  result <- terra::ifel(denominator == 0, NA, numerator / denominator)
  names(result) <- "Custom_Index"
  result
})

is_gli_formula <- reactive({
  identical(input$num_band_a, "Green") && input$num_a == 2 &&
    identical(input$num_op_1, "-") && identical(input$num_band_b, "Red") && input$num_b == 1 &&
    identical(input$num_op_2, "-") && identical(input$num_band_c, "Blue") && input$num_c == 1 &&
    identical(input$den_band_a, "Green") && input$den_a == 2 &&
    identical(input$den_op_1, "+") && identical(input$den_band_b, "Red") && input$den_b == 1 &&
    identical(input$den_op_2, "+") && identical(input$den_band_c, "Blue") && input$den_c == 1
})

output$formula_feedback <- renderUI({
  shiny::req(input$calculate_custom_index > 0)
  if (is_gli_formula()) {
    div(class = "alert alert-success", "Correct. The constructed expression is the Green Leaf Index.")
  } else {
    div(class = "alert alert-warning", "The custom index was calculated, but the selected expression is not the standard GLI formula.")
  }
})

output$custom_index_map <- renderLeaflet({
  index <- custom_index()
  values <- terra::values(index, mat = FALSE)
  finite_values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  shiny::validate(shiny::need(length(finite_values) > 0, "The selected formula did not produce finite values."))
  palette <- colorNumeric("RdYlGn", domain = finite_values, na.color = "transparent")

  leaflet(options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE)) |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, group = "Light basemap") |>
    leaflet::addRasterImage(
      index,
      colors = palette,
      opacity = 0.9,
      project = TRUE,
      group = "Calculated index"
    ) |>
    addLayersControl(
      baseGroups = "Light basemap",
      overlayGroups = "Calculated index",
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
    ) |>
    addLegend(pal = palette, values = finite_values, title = "Index value")
})

output$custom_index_histogram <- renderPlotly({
  values <- terra::values(custom_index(), mat = FALSE)
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  plot_ly(x = values, type = "histogram", nbinsx = 80, name = "Custom index") |>
    plotly::layout(
      title = "Calculated Index Distribution",
      xaxis = list(title = "Index value"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Pixel count")
    )
})
```

### Run the equivalent R code

After building the formula interactively, run the reproducible R code yourself.

```{r calculate-gli, exercise=TRUE}
rgb <- rgb_raw
names(rgb) <- c("Red", "Green", "Blue")

red <- rgb[["Red"]]
green <- rgb[["Green"]]
blue <- rgb[["Blue"]]

gli <- (2 * green - red - blue) / (2 * green + red + blue)
names(gli) <- "GLI"

plot(gli, col = hcl.colors(100, "RdYlGn"), main = "Green Leaf Index")
terra::global(gli, c("min", "mean", "max"), na.rm = TRUE)
```

## Activity 5: Calculate an Otsu threshold

Otsu thresholding separates the GLI distribution into vegetation and background classes by maximizing between-class variance.

```{r otsu-threshold, exercise=TRUE}
gli <- safe_gli(rgb_raw[["Red"]], rgb_raw[["Green"]], rgb_raw[["Blue"]])
names(gli) <- "GLI"

otsu_threshold <- calculate_otsu_threshold(gli)
otsu_threshold
```

```{r otsu-display, echo=FALSE}
verbatimTextOutput("otsu_value")
plotOutput("otsu_histogram", height = "380px")
```

```{r otsu-display-server, context="server", echo=FALSE}
otsu_reactive <- reactive({
  gli_layer <- safe_gli(
    red = rgb_raw[["Red"]],
    green = rgb_raw[["Green"]],
    blue = rgb_raw[["Blue"]]
  )
  names(gli_layer) <- "GLI"
  calculate_otsu_threshold(gli_layer)
})

output$otsu_value <- renderText({
  paste("Calculated Otsu GLI threshold:", round(otsu_reactive(), 4))
})

output$otsu_histogram <- renderPlot({
  gli_layer <- safe_gli(
    red = rgb_raw[["Red"]],
    green = rgb_raw[["Green"]],
    blue = rgb_raw[["Blue"]]
  )
  values <- terra::values(gli_layer, mat = FALSE)
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]

  hist(
    values,
    breaks = 80,
    col = "grey80",
    border = "white",
    main = "GLI Distribution and Otsu Threshold",
    xlab = "GLI"
  )
  abline(v = otsu_reactive(), col = "red", lwd = 3, lty = 2)
  legend(
    "topright",
    legend = paste("Threshold =", round(otsu_reactive(), 4)),
    col = "red",
    lty = 2,
    lwd = 3
  )
})
```

## Activity 6: Create a binary vegetation mask

Pixels with GLI greater than the Otsu threshold are classified as vegetation.

```{r binary-mask, exercise=TRUE}
vegetation_mask <- terra::ifel(gli > otsu_threshold, 1, 0)
names(vegetation_mask) <- "Vegetation_Mask"

plot(
  vegetation_mask,
  col = c("grey85", "forestgreen"),
  main = "Binary Vegetation Mask"
)
```

```text
0 = non-vegetation
1 = vegetation
```

## Activity 7: Mask the RGB orthomosaic and GLI layer

```{r apply-mask, exercise=TRUE}
vegetation_rgb <- rgb * vegetation_only_mask

)
```

### Interactive overlay

```{r plot-overlay-ui, echo=FALSE}
leafletOutput("plot_overlay_map", height = "560px")
```

```{r plot-overlay-server, context="server", echo=FALSE}
analysis_objects <- reactive({
  gli <- safe_gli(
    red = rgb_raw[["Red"]],
    green = rgb_raw[["Green"]],
    blue = rgb_raw[["Blue"]]
  )
  names(gli) <- "GLI"
  threshold <- calculate_otsu_threshold(gli)
  mask <- terra::ifel(gli > threshold, 1, 0)
  names(mask) <- "Vegetation_Mask"
  vegetation_gli <- terra::ifel(mask == 1, gli, NA)
  names(vegetation_gli) <- "Vegetation_GLI"
  plots <- make_aligned_plots(vegetation_gli, plots_raw)

  list(
    gli = gli,
    threshold = threshold,
    mask = mask,
    vegetation_gli = vegetation_gli,
    plots = plots
  )
})

output$plot_overlay_map <- renderLeaflet({
  obj <- analysis_objects()
  values <- terra::values(obj$vegetation_gli, mat = FALSE)
  finite_values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  pal <- colorNumeric("YlGn", domain = finite_values, na.color = "transparent")
  plot_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(obj$plots)

  all_gli_values <- terra::values(obj$gli, mat = FALSE)
  all_gli_values <- all_gli_values[is.finite(all_gli_values)]
  all_gli_pal <- colorNumeric("RdYlGn", domain = all_gli_values, na.color = "transparent")
  mask_pal <- colorFactor(c("transparent", "forestgreen"), domain = c(0, 1), na.color = "transparent")

  leaflet(options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE)) |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, group = "Light basemap") |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") |>
    leaflet::addRasterImage(
      obj$gli,
      colors = all_gli_pal,
      opacity = 0.8,
      project = TRUE,
      group = "All-pixel GLI"
    ) |>
    leaflet::addRasterImage(
      obj$mask,
      colors = mask_pal,
      opacity = 0.65,
      project = TRUE,
      group = "Vegetation mask"
    ) |>
    leaflet::addRasterImage(
      obj$vegetation_gli,
      colors = pal,
      opacity = 0.9,
      project = TRUE,
      group = "Vegetation GLI"
    ) |>
    addPolygons(
      data = sf::st_transform(plot_sf, 4326),
      color = "#111827",
      weight = 1.5,
      fill = FALSE,
      label = as.character(plot_sf[[plot_id_field]]),
      group = "Plot boundaries"
    ) |>
    addLayersControl(
      baseGroups = c("Light basemap", "Satellite"),
      overlayGroups = c("All-pixel GLI", "Vegetation mask", "Vegetation GLI", "Plot boundaries"),
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
    ) |>
    addLegend(pal = pal, values = finite_values, title = "Vegetation GLI")
})
```

## Activity 9: Extract plot-level crop traits

For each plot, calculate mean vegetation GLI, GLI standard deviation, and canopy cover percentage.

```{r extract-traits, exercise=TRUE}
plots <- make_aligned_plots(vegetation_gli, plots_raw)

mean_gli <- terra::extract(
  vegetation_gli,
  plots,
  fun = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  exact = TRUE
)

sd_gli <- terra::extract(
  vegetation_gli,
  plots,
  fun = sd,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  exact = TRUE
)

canopy_cover <- terra::extract(
  vegetation_mask,
  plots,
  fun = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  exact = TRUE
)

plot_level_traits <- data.frame(
  plot_id = as.data.frame(plots)[[plot_id_field]],
  mean_vegetation_gli = mean_gli[, 2],
  sd_vegetation_gli = sd_gli[, 2],
  canopy_cover_percent = 100 * canopy_cover[, 2]
)

head(plot_level_traits)
```

### Final interactive trait table

```{r final-table-ui, echo=FALSE}
DTOutput("trait_table")
downloadButton("download_traits", "Download Plot-Level Crop Traits")
```

```{r final-table-server, context="server", echo=FALSE}
plot_traits_reactive <- reactive({
  obj <- analysis_objects()
  plots <- obj$plots

  mean_result <- terra::extract(
    obj$vegetation_gli, plots,
    fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE, exact = TRUE
  )
  sd_result <- terra::extract(
    obj$vegetation_gli, plots,
    fun = sd, na.rm = TRUE, exact = TRUE
  )
  cover_result <- terra::extract(
    obj$mask, plots,
    fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE, exact = TRUE
  )

  data.frame(
    plot_id = as.data.frame(plots)[[plot_id_field]],
    mean_vegetation_gli = round(mean_result[, 2], 4),
    sd_vegetation_gli = round(sd_result[, 2], 4),
    canopy_cover_percent = round(100 * cover_result[, 2], 2),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

output$trait_table <- renderDT({
  datatable(
    plot_traits_reactive(),
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
})

output$download_traits <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() "plot_level_rgb_gli_traits.csv",
  content = function(file) {
    write.csv(plot_traits_reactive(), file, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  }
)
```

## Activity 10: Interpret plot-level variation

```{r trait-summary-ui, echo=FALSE}
plotlyOutput("plot_trait_chart", height = "480px")
verbatimTextOutput("top_plot_summary")
```

```{r trait-summary-server, context="server", echo=FALSE}
output$plot_trait_chart <- renderPlotly({
  traits <- plot_traits_reactive()

  plot_ly(
    traits,
    x = ~reorder(as.character(plot_id), mean_vegetation_gli),
    y = ~mean_vegetation_gli,
    type = "bar",
    marker = list(color = ~mean_vegetation_gli, colorscale = "Viridis")
  ) |>
    plotly::layout(
      title = "Mean Vegetation GLI by Plot",
      xaxis = list(title = "Plot ID", tickangle = -45),
      yaxis = list(title = "Mean vegetation GLI")
    )
})

output$top_plot_summary <- renderText({
  traits <- plot_traits_reactive()
  valid_gli <- which(is.finite(traits$mean_vegetation_gli))
  valid_cover <- which(is.finite(traits$canopy_cover_percent))

  if (length(valid_gli) == 0 || length(valid_cover) == 0) {
    return("No valid plot-level output was available.")
  }

  best_gli <- traits[valid_gli[which.max(traits$mean_vegetation_gli[valid_gli])], ]
  best_cover <- traits[valid_cover[which.max(traits$canopy_cover_percent[valid_cover])], ]

  paste0(
    "Highest mean vegetation GLI: ", best_gli$plot_id,
    " (", best_gli$mean_vegetation_gli, ")\n",
    "Highest canopy cover: ", best_cover$plot_id,
    " (", best_cover$canopy_cover_percent, "%)"
  )
})
```
